title: Broadcaster John Stapleton dies aged 79
summary: Stapleton, who had Parkinson’s disease complicated by pneumonia, died peacefully in hospital, his agent said The broadcaster John Stapleton, who had Parkinson’s disease complicated by pneumonia, died peacefully in hospital early on Sunday morning, his agent said. He was 79. Stapleton presented on programmes including the BBC’s Watchdog and GMTV’s News Hour. Continue reading...
